identity_read.note: Bold MPN, the caption 'CURRENT-LIMITED SWITCH' (the SLVSDL7 p1 title words, p13 9.1) and IN->OUT straight across the top row make it read as a current-limited power switch at a glance. IN top-left counts as supply on top under the Lead ruling; GND is on the bottom (D-54).

silicon_faithfulness.note: All six pins match the SLVSDL7 p4 Pin Functions TPS2553D DBV column by number, name and type (1 IN power_in, 2 GND, 3 EN input with no overbar, 4 ~{FAULT} open_collector, 5 ILIM passive per p17, 6 OUT power_out). '2.7-6.5V' matches p5 7.3, so the 2.5 V value of the parent part is not carried over. '15k-232k to GND' matches p5 RILIM and p15 9.5.1. The Description's 1.295 A typ at 20k (p7), 75 mA ILIM-to-IN (p7, p15), OUT > IN + 135 mV, 4 ms (p7, p14) and OT immediate (p14) are all correct. No contradiction found.

economy.note: There is no internal ink, as D-54 asks. The body holds three notes: supply range, a class caption and a two-line RILIM note. The class caption is beyond D-54's 'a short note or two' (supply range, active level) and repeats the Description. The lower-left of the 25.4x15.24 body is empty. The MPN prints twice (bold body title plus the visible Value), a cost all three designs share.

wiring_ergonomics.note: IN and EN are on the left 5.08 apart, OUT and ~{FAULT} on the right, GND and ILIM on the bottom 5.08 apart. RILIM therefore drops straight from ILIM to a ground beside GND, the short route p15 asks for. This board's EN-to-IN tie (architecture.md U17 paragraph; p4, p5 VEN to 6.5 V) is a straight jumper at the pin ends that crosses no other pin. Every pin end is on the 100 mil grid (x +-17.78/+-2.54, y 5.08/0/-12.7).

expressibility.note: The body states the supply range (p5), the RILIM range and that it goes to GND (p5, p15), and the part class. It has no EN active-level note, although D-54 names active level and p4 makes polarity part-number dependent (TPS2552D EN-bar vs TPS2553D EN). The bare 'EN' name implies it but does not say it. Open drain on FAULT shows only through the overbar and pin type. The 75 mA ILIM-to-IN option appears only in the Description.

identity_read.note: Bold MPN plus the datasheet pin names IN/OUT/EN/~{FAULT}/ILIM and the 'RILIM 15k-232k' note make it read as a resistor-programmed load switch. There is no class word, so 'current-limited' rides on the RILIM note alone. IN top-left counts as supply on top (Lead ruling); GND is on the bottom.

silicon_faithfulness.note: Pins match the p4 TPS2553D DBV column by number, name and type. '2.7-6.5V' matches p5 7.3. economy.note: Smallest body (25.4x12.7). The three notes are exactly what D-54 asks for (supply range on IN, active level on EN, RILIM range on ILIM), one short line each. There is no decorative or internal ink; the only spare ink is the MPN title that all three designs share.

wiring_ergonomics.note: The power path runs straight along the top row. EN sits 2.54 under IN, so this board's EN-to-IN tie is a one-pitch jumper. ILIM beside GND on the bottom lets RILIM drop straight down (p15 short trace). However, the side pin rows (y 3.81, 1.27) and the bottom pin ends (y -11.43) are on the 50 mil grid, not 100 mil. gen.py's docstring claims 'Every pin tip sits on the 2.54 mm grid', which is true only for x. Wires still connect on the engine's 1.27 GRID, but this falls short of the 100 mil convention the other two designs meet.

expressibility.note: The body states supply range, active level and RILIM range: the D-54 note set. It does not say RILIM goes to GND (p5 defines it 'from ILIM to GND'). FAULT's open drain shows only through the pin type and overbar. The 75 mA ILIM-to-IN option, the reverse-voltage turn-off and the FAULT deglitch are only in the Description, which is acceptable under D-54.

identity_read.note: No class word. The ILIM notes ('15k-232k to GND', 'or to IN: 75mA') and the FAULT notes say current-limited switch with a fault flag. silicon_faithfulness.note: Pins match p4 by number, name and type. Every note checks out: 2.7-6.5V (p5), active high (p4), open drain (p4), deglitch OC 7.5 ms / rev 4 ms typ (p7, p14), 15k-232k to GND (p5), 75 mA tied to IN typ (p7 50/75/100, p15). economy.note: Six caption lines, where D-54 asks for 'a short note or two'. 'open drain' repeats what the overbar and pin type already carry. The deglitch timings (p7) are datasheet detail the Description already holds. The body is 35.56x20.32 mm, about twice the area of the others for six pins.

wiring_ergonomics.note: ~{FAULT} sits between IN and EN on the left. On this board EN is tied to IN (architecture.md U17 paragraph) and FAULT is left open (D-45), so a straight vertical tie at the pin ends (x -22.86, y 7.62 to -2.54) would pass FAULT's pin end at y 2.54 and short the open-drain FAULT to IN (p5: FAULT sink 25 mA abs max). The tie has to jog out around it. The output also sits on the input edge, unlike the stock TPS2051CDBV convention. ILIM on the right with GND under the body makes RILIM an L route rather than a straight drop. All pin ends are on the 100 mil grid, and the p1-style RFAULT pull-up to IN is easy.

expressibility.note: The body alone states the active level, open drain, deglitch timing, the RILIM range and that it goes to GND, and the ILIM-to-IN 75 mA option (p4, p5, p7, p15). A reader can wire and debug the part without opening SLVSDL7. Strongest of the three on this axis.

identity_read.note: Plain D-54 box, no block diagram: IN (1) top-left and OUT (6) top-right on one row, so the IN->OUT path reads straight across, and the 'CURRENT-LIMITED SWITCH' centre caption names the part's class at a glance. That is the p1 title 'Current-Limited Power-Distribution Switches' and p13 9.1. GND (2) sits on the bottom and IN is top-left, which meets D-54 under the Lead ruling.

silicon_faithfulness.note: Pins match p4, and EN has no overbar. Every caption is datasheet-backed. '2.7-6.5V' is p5. 'open drain' is p4 and p14 9.3.3. The p1 drawing does this for its RFAULT pull-up to IN, but on U17 (EN tied on, FAULT open) the EN-to-IN strap has to detour around FAULT's pin end. ILIM on the right puts RILIM on the output side rather than beside GND.

expressibility.note: It gives the most complete wiring story of the three: supply range, EN level, FAULT open drain with its deglitch, the RILIM range and the ILIM-to-IN 75 mA option (p4, p5, p7, p14, p15). The cost of carrying all that is scored under economy.

identity_read.note: Unit 1 reads as a current-limited switch at a glance: 'CURRENT-LIMITED SWITCH' caption (SLVSDL7 p1 title, p13 9.1), IN top-left and OUT top-right on one row (p13 Figure 9.2 power rail IN left to OUT right; p1 Simplified Schematic the same), EN under IN, ~{FAULT} under OUT, GND+ILIM on the bottom. Supply on top per the Lead ruling (IN top-left), ground on the bottom (D-54). Only design that names the part class on the body.

silicon_faithfulness.note: All six pins match p4 Pin Functions TPS2553D DBV column and pins.json: 1 IN power_in, 2 GND power_in, 3 EN input with no overbar (p4 'EN = Active High for the TPS2553D'), 4 ~{FAULT} open_collector (p4 'Active-low open-drain'), 5 ILIM passive (p17 'never driven directly'), 6 OUT power_out; no EP (p4 PowerPAD '-'). '2.7-6.5V' matches p5 7.3 VIN (not the parent's 2.5 V), '15k-232k to GND' matches p5 RILIM 'from ILIM to GND 15 232'. Body 25.4 x 15.24 mm; the extra row over flow-first is the 5.08 mm IN/EN pitch, which pays for itself in wiring. Nothing on the body repeats a pin type.

ILIM beside GND on the bottom so RILIM (p5 'from ILIM to GND'; p15 'traces as short as possible') hangs straight down to its own ground; ~{FAULT} leaves on the right toward its pull-up and the MCU (U17_FAULT_N). Fanout render is clean.

expressibility.note: Expresses class, supply range and ILIM programming range to GND. Does not ink the EN active level that D-54's reading names (relies on the un-barred name, correct per p4), and the ILIM-to-IN 75 mA option (p7, p15) and FAULT deglitch (p7, p14) live only in the Description. Meets the bar.

identity_read.note: Unit 1: IN top-left / OUT top-right on one row (p13 Figure 9.2, p1), EN and ~{FAULT} directly under them, GND+ILIM on the bottom; notes '2.7-6.5V', 'H = ON', 'RILIM 15k-232k'. Supply on top per the Lead ruling, ground on the bottom (D-54). The pin set and the RILIM note identify a programmable load switch, but no class word on the body: identity rests on the MPN title and pin names.

silicon_faithfulness.note: Pins match p4 Pin Functions TPS2553D DBV column exactly (names, numbers, etypes as pins.json; EN un-barred per p4, ~{FAULT} open_collector per p4, ILIM passive per p17). silicon_faithfulness.note: Pins match p4 Pin Functions TPS2553D DBV column and pins.json (EN un-barred, ~{FAULT} open_collector, ILIM passive, OUT power_out, no EP). Captions all check: '2.7-6.5V' p5 7.3; 'open drain' p4 FAULT row; 'deglitch OC 7.5ms, rev 4ms' p7 FAULT deglitch typ and p14 9.3.3 (uses the table's 7.5 ms, not the figure's '8-ms'); 'active high' p4; '15k-232k to GND' p5 RILIM; 'or to IN: 75mA' p7 'ILIM shorted to IN 50 75 100', p15. wiring_ergonomics.note: IN top-left (series-switch supply), OUT right, GND pin 2 at the bottom, ILIM at the bottom beside it with its note; inputs left, outputs right, no crossings, pin spacing leaves room for labels.

expressibility.note: ILIM note states the RILIM-to-GND requirement and the range from p4; active-high EN and open-drain FAULT overbar are visible. Enough to wire the part without the datasheet.

identity_read.note: Body title TPS2553DDBVR; names IN, EN, OUT, FAULT (overbar), GND, ILIM with numbers 1-6 match the p4 pin table (IN1 GND2 EN3 FAULT4 ILIM5 OUT6). Active-high EN note matches p4 'EN = Active High for the TPS2553D'.

silicon_faithfulness.note: Pin names, numbers and overbar on FAULT match p4; 'active high' on EN and '2.7-6.5V' match the p1 operating range; '15k-232k to GND' matches the p4 ILIM row. No internal block drawn, no invented pins, no PowerPAD (DBV has none).

economy.note: Three short notes only (2.7-6.5V, active high, 15k-232k to GND); no block diagram; six pins, six names, nothing redundant. Fits D-54.

wiring_ergonomics.note: IN top-left (supply on top per D-54), OUT/FAULT right, GND bottom; inputs left, outputs right. ILIM also exits the bottom beside GND, which suits a resistor to ground but sits close to the GND pin; stubs are long but clear.

expressibility.note: Notes carry the supply range, enable polarity and RILIM range from p4/p1, which is enough to wire it right without opening the datasheet; open-drain FAULT is shown by the overbar name.
